videos.title: Atma Vichara · Self and Other
videos.description: This meditation explores one of the deepest questions in contemplative practice: where does "I" end and "other" begin? Drawing from yogic and Vedantic inquiry traditions, this guided session invites you to examine the boundary between self and world with curiosity rather than assumption. A practice that has the potential to quietly shift how you move through every relationship in your life.

videos.title: Ashtanga Surya Namaskar
videos.description: The Ashtanga Sun Salutation is the dynamic, breath-led foundation of one of yoga's most rigorous classical traditions. This sequence works the whole body, builds heat, and asks for steady focus. Whether you're new to Ashtanga or deepening an existing practice, surya namaskar is a staple morning practice.

videos.title: Anulom Vilom Pranayama
videos.description: Anulom Vilom is an alternate-nostril breathing technique from the Hatha Yoga tradition, documented in classical texts like the Hatha Yoga Pradipika. You breathe in and out through one nostril at a time, a practice yogic philosophy describes as balancing the ida and pingala nadis (energy channels). Many people use it to slow down, settle the mind and sharpen focus.

videos.title: Guided Meditation: Awareness
videos.description: Natural Awareness is the recognition that consciousness itself is the ground of all experience: open, effortless, already present. This meditation guides you into that recognition without forcing or manufacturing a state, drawing from the non-dual traditions woven throughout South Asian contemplative wisdom. Less doing, more being, and a taste of what's always already here.

videos.title: Yamas and Niyamas the Foundation of Yoga
videos.description: Before the postures, before the breathwork, before any technique, there are the Yamas and Niyamas. These ten ethical and personal observances from Patanjali's Yoga Sutras form the true foundation of the yogic path, offering a framework for how to live, not just how to practice. This session introduces each one and explores how they show up, and how to apply them, in the context of modern life.
